│ The nightly batch exporter writes every record twice when a retry overlaps the
│ previous run, and the downstream loader rejects the whole file on the first   
│ duplicate key. Which way should we handle it before the next release?       
                               
❯ 1. Fix it in the exporter       ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
    before merging                │ Where:  exporter retry path              │
    (Recommended)                 │ When:   in this PR, pre-merge            │
  2. Separate change, before      │ Risk:   low, root cause fixed            │
    release                       │ Loader: unchanged                        │
  3. File it for later            └──────────────────────────────────────────┘
